name: sqlingo-t1-bigquery-ts
instr:
SQL expression helpers and dialect round trips no longer work after the refactor

Our SQL tooling used to build and inspect expression trees, replace placeholders, and parse and generate SQL across dialects. Callers rely on these operations to construct queries and move them between database dialects without assembling SQL strings by hand.

Could you restore all the stubbed source implementations behind expression helpers and dialect round trips in `@hdnax/sqlingo.js`? Stubbed bodies currently throw `new Error("not implemented")`. The affected files are `src/expressions/expressions.ts`, `src/helper.ts`, `src/parser/index.ts`, `src/generator.ts`, `src/dialects/bigquery.ts`, `src/dialects/hive.ts`, and `src/dialects/snowflake.ts`. This includes expression construction and accessors, source expansion and placeholder replacement, shared helpers, parsing, SQL generation, and the dialect routines used by those operations.

Some BigQuery overrides were removed entirely. Restore `BigQueryParser.parseTablePart`, `BigQueryParser.parseTableParts`, and `BigQuery.normalizeIdentifier` so table paths retain dialect-specific qualification and quoting, and identifier normalization respects case sensitivity.

Preserve existing passing source behavior and public API names. `FEATURE.md` at the repository root defines the interface, conventions, and sandbox limits; its conventions resolve ambiguities in the doc comments. `README.npm.md` provides usage context.
